sources.title: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Suggest to use bge v1.5, which alleviates the issue of the similarity distribution. Since we finetune the models by contrastive learning with a temperature of 0.01, the similarity distribution of the current BGE model is about in the interval [0.6, 1].

sources.snippet: BGE v1 & v1.5 # BGE v1 and v1.5 are series of encoder only models base on BERT. They achieved best performance among the models of the same size at the time of release. BGE # The first group of BGE models was released in Aug 2023. The bge-large-en and bge-large-zh ranked 1st on MTEB and C-MTEB benchmarks at the time released.

sources.snippet: Download bge-base-en-v1.5 for free. Efficient English embedding model for semantic search and retrieval. bge-base-en-v1.5 is an English sentence embedding model from BAAI optimized for dense retrieval tasks, part of the BGE (BAAI General Embedding) family. It is a fine-tuned BERT-based model designed to produce high-quality, semantically meaningful embeddings for tasks like semantic similarity ...
